codeReview.summary: The fix correctly updates use-payments.ts to use camelCase properties matching the CreateAbonoInput and UpdateAbonoInput interfaces. All required changes were made: customer_id → customerId, seller_id → sellerId, payment_method → paymentMethod, reference_number → referenceNumber, proof_image_id → proofImageId. The worker also correctly reverted accidental changes to lines 129 and 131 which were in the onSuccess callback where data is of type Abono (database entity) and correctly uses snake_case. Typecheck shows only the pre-existing businessUserId error (unrelated to this fix), and build succeeds.
